settings.headline:

go to bed hungry.
settings.copy: Harvest Table rescues fresh surplus from farms, grocers, and bakeries and turns it into free weekly groceries for the neighbors who need them — with dignity, and no judgement.

settings.title: A full circle,
settings.intro: Hunger is a logistics problem with a human face. We run the logistics so the dignity can come first.

features.title: Rescue the surplus
features.text: Our refrigerated vans collect imperfect produce, day-old bakery, and overstock from farms and grocers that would otherwise go to waste.

features.title: Sort & store
features.text: Volunteers sort and date everything in our 40,000 sq ft warehouse, keeping fresh food fresh and safe.

features.title: Stock the pantries
features.text: Every week we deliver full, grocery-style distributions across 30 neighborhood pantry sites countywide.

features.title: Serve with dignity
features.text: Families shop their own carts at a pantry, in private, no vouchers or line-ups — the way a grocery aisle should work.

features.title: Feed the kids
features.text: Weekend backpacks and school holiday packs make sure no child goes without when the cafeteria is closed.

features.title: Grow the next meal
features.text: A small teaching farm grows fresh greens for the pantry and teaches neighbors to grow their own.

settings.title: Getting help is

steps.title: Find a pantry
steps.text: Use our site or call our helpline to find the pantry site and hours nearest you. No referral, no appointment.

steps.title: Walk in & shop
steps.text: Sign in with a first name only. Then shop the aisles like a grocery store — a half-cart or a full cart, your call.

steps.title: Take what you need
steps.text: No limits, no means test, no questions. You can come back every week. When you're ready, you simply don't need to anymore.

settings.note: Groceries are free and unlimited. If you need more than the weekly cart, our staff will quietly make sure you get it.

settings.title: A table is set
settings.quote: A community that feeds its children, its seniors, and its tired is not a community in crisis — it is one quietly taking care of its own.

settings.title: A full cart,
settings.intro: What the people we serve want the community to know.

reviews.quote: I went from being a regular donor to needing help after my hours got cut. The dignity of just walking in and choosing my own groceries — it changed how I felt about asking.
reviews.author: Maria T.

reviews.quote: The weekend backpacks mean my kids eat well when school's closed, and I don't have to choose between groceries and their bus money.
reviews.author: DeShawn P.

reviews.quote: I volunteer every Saturday. Everyone is welcome here, no questions, and the produce is genuinely fresh. It's the most hopeful room in the county.
reviews.author: Adele R.

settings.title: Need-based help,
settings.intro: One short email each week with pantry hours, volunteer shifts, and what food is flowing. No guilt, no spam, unsubscribe anytime.

settings.title: We're here for you
settings.intro: Need food, want to donate, or looking to volunteer? Tell us what you need and our small team will point you the right way.
settings.form_title: We'll get right back to you

settings.blurb: A countywide food bank that rescues fresh surplus and gets it to the tables of neighbors who need it — with dignity, every week.
